posts.title: Yellow Rose
posts.description: The yellow rose is not a flower I’m familiar with, and certainly doesn’t have the characteristic petal shape of the very ornamental garden roses, but considering there’s over 300 species of rose, I think it’s ok if I don’t recognise them immediately. Perhaps this is unfamiliar because it’s native to China, Mongolia, and Korea!

posts.title: Remembering Green
posts.description: As December is just around the corner, it’s nice to remember just how vividly green Berlin is in the spring and summer. This was the site of a small birthday celebration for two friends – absolutely bursting with new life and growth.

posts.title: Red Squirrel In Grey
posts.description: A beautiful and healthy looking red squirrel pauses on the forest floor just long enough for me to focus and capture a photo before they bounded off on their merry way. The light was a little low resulting in a slightly noisy image, and it felt like it looked better in black and white.
